artboards.title: Letters · editable To + Cc, and what Send does

annotations.text: OWNER ASK, 2026-10-09 — edit the To and Cc lines, and a note that says exactly what happens on Send. To was only changeable when picked by hand; a Key-Contacts match had no Change link. Cc was built once and pulled (ace2c95) because reply sync can't tell a copied spouse's reply-all from the agency's.
